preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 200000.
The distance d must be between 2 and n.
There must be exactly n-1 edges forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge nodes must be within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= m1 <= n and len(a) == m1 and all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: The sequence a must contain distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= m2 <= n and len(b) == m2 and all(1 <= bi <= n for bi in b)
preconditions.description: The sequence b must contain distinct integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum steps required to move the pieces according to the sequences.
